primary.$description: The accent fill: the one main button per screen, checked checkboxes, the job progress bar. Light: accent 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 4.53:1 on surface-selected, 5.52:1 on surface-raised.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.52:1 on primary, 8.56:1 on primary-hover.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of primary fills. Light: accent 650.

primary-container.$description: The accent at low strength for small marks only (a selected tab underline background, a count badge). Not for rows or blocks: in dark it is a deep violet (quality.craft.both-themes). Light: accent 150.

on-primary-container.$description: Text on primary-container. Light: accent 750. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.92:1 on primary-container.

secondary.$description: Neutral fill (no second brand hue): toggled toolbar buttons. Light: neutral 700.

on-secondary.$description: Text on secondary. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 10.35:1 on secondary.

secondary-container.$description: Neutral fill: the Assigned chip, inactive segmented controls, filter chips. Light: neutral 150.

on-secondary-container.$description: Text on secondary-container. Light: neutral 650. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 7.03:1 on secondary-container.

surface.$description: Page canvas behind everything. Light: neutral 50.

surface-raised.$description: Panels, tables, forms on the canvas; lifted by shadow-raised (dark: one stop lighter than the page, plus the shadow). Light: white.

surface-overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs, with shadow-overlay. Light: white.

surface-hover.$description: Hover on rows, list items, and ghost/secondary controls that sit on surface-raised (dark: one stop lighter than raised). Light: neutral 100.

surface-selected.$description: Selected rows and list items: one neutral step stronger than surface-hover, in both themes (quality.craft.quiet-states). The accent appears only as a detail: the checked box and the primary left edge. Light: neutral 150.

surface-overlay-hover.$description: Highlighted item inside a floating layer (menu, select, combobox): one stop off surface-overlay. Light: neutral 100.

surface-subtle.$description: Quiet zones and inset wells: the sidebar, a toolbar band, inline messages inside panels. Same tone as the page. Light: neutral 50.

surface-featured.$description: The one thing a screen leads with (the job that needs action), with shadow-featured. Light: white.

on-surface-inverse.$description: Text on surface-inverse. Light: neutral 50. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 15.19:1 on surface-inverse.

surface-brand.$description: The brand block: solid accent, used only where the emphasis map says (Reports headline). The one large area of accent. Light: accent 600.

on-surface-brand.$description: Text on surface-brand. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.96:1 on surface-brand.

on-surface-brand-muted.$description: Secondary text on surface-brand. Light: accent 200. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.06:1 on surface-brand.

on-surface.$description: Default text and icons on every neutral surface. Light: neutral 850. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 12.8:1 on primary-container, 15.19:1 on surface, 15.7:1 on surface-raised, 15.7:1 on surface-overlay, 14.2:1 on surface-hover, 14.2:1 on surface-overlay-hover, 15.7:1 on surface-featured, 15.19:1 on surface-subtle, 12.88:1 on surface-selected.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text: metadata, column headers, timestamps, placeholders. Light: neutral 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 6.75:1 on surface, 6.98:1 on surface-raised, 6.98:1 on surface-overlay, 6.31:1 on surface-hover, 6.98:1 on surface-featured, 5.69:1 on primary-container, 6.31:1 on surface-overlay-hover, 5.73:1 on surface-selected, 6.75:1 on surface-subtle, 5.73:1 on secondary-container, 6.75:1 on surface.

on-surface-faint.$description: Tertiary text: least important metadata, empty-cell dashes. Never for anything a person must read to act. Light: neutral 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.37:1 on surface, 5.56:1 on surface-raised, 5.56:1 on surface-featured.

border.$description: Hairlines: dividers between table rows and under the table header. Decorative; not required to meet 3:1. Light: neutral 200.

border-strong.$description: Edges of controls people must find: inputs, selects, combobox, checkboxes, secondary and destructive buttons. Light: neutral 500. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 3.61:1 on surface-selected, 4.25:1 on surface, 4.4:1 on surface-raised, 4.4:1 on surface-overlay, 3.98:1 on surface-hover.

border-focus.$description: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Light: accent 500. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 3.59:1 on surface-selected, 4.23:1 on surface, 4.37:1 on surface-raised, 4.37:1 on surface-overlay, 4.37:1 on surface-featured.

link.$description: Inline text links (underlined). Light: accent 600. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.71:1 on surface-selected, 6.73:1 on surface, 6.96:1 on surface-raised, 6.96:1 on surface-featured.

error.$description: Error text and icons on surfaces; destructive outline; Parts hold dot. Light: red 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 5.54:1 on surface-raised, 5.54:1 on surface-overlay, 5.36:1 on surface, 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 5.54:1 on surface-raised, 4.53:1 on error-container.

on-error.$description: Text on error fills. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.54:1 on error.

error-container.$description: Parts hold chips and other small marks (not message blocks). Light: red 150.

on-error-container.$description: Text on error-container. Light: red 750. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.97:1 on error-container, 12.19:1 on surface-overlay.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons; Running late dot. Light: amber 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 5.54:1 on surface-raised, 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 4.52:1 on warning-container.

on-warning.$description: Text on warning fills. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.54:1 on warning.

warning-container.$description: Running late chips and other small marks. Light: amber 150.

on-warning-container.$description: Text on warning-container. Light: amber 750. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.93:1 on warning-container.

success.$description: Success text and icons; On site and Done dots. Light: green 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.32:1 on surface-subtle, 5.51:1 on surface-raised, 5.32:1 on surface-subtle, 4.51:1 on success-container.

on-success.$description: Text on success fills. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.51:1 on success.

success-container.$description: On site and Done chips and other small marks. Light: green 150.

on-success-container.$description: Text on success-container. Light: green 750. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.97:1 on success-container.

info.$description: Info text and icons; En route dot. Distinct from the violet accent by hue (blue about 263, violet about 293). Light: blue 550. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 5.54:1 on surface-raised, 5.36:1 on surface-subtle, 4.53:1 on info-container.

on-info.$description: Text on info fills. Light: white. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 5.54:1 on info.

info-container.$description: En route chips and other small marks. Light: blue 150.

on-info-container.$description: Text on info-container. Light: blue 750. Contrast (wcag-2.2 AA, contrast tool): 9.95:1 on info-container.
